correctness.rationale: Enumerating independent sets as centre singleton or at most one peripheral vertex per block produces W=(-1)^a+∏(r+1-2|u_j|). Odd r factors even, so all W odd and min1 reached when a factor vanishes; even r factors odd and W=0 precisely when every |u_j|=m or m+1, uniquely fixing central bit, count T_m^n, min nonzero2. The central two-layer Krawtchouk coefficient generating polynomial and recurrence produce pairwise alternating signed double-factorial ratios and exact absolute sum S_m=2^m T_m. Explicit Fourier inversion gives projection kernel total variation 1+(S_m^n-T_m^n)/2^(2mn). Averaging arbitrary projections over all Boolean translations gives this minimum over all linear projections, not just convolution. Independently recomputed local absolute sums exactly for m=1..8; source small-parameter checker code and boundary r=1,n=1 inspected. General proof is algebraic, not finite enumeration.
